description: Backports Minecraft NBT structures to 1.7.10 with full jigsaw support, and fixes some Mojank along the way!

block: Connects multiple structures together$The block it turns into on generation can be changed by placing a block on it
Defines an area for saving/loading structures
Defines where air should be placed when the containing structure generates
Functions like a Jigsaw Block, but attaches the$target piece §6after§r all surrounding chunks have been fully generated.
Spawns a chest (or any block with an inventory)$The block can be changed by placing an inventory containing block on it
item: "Replication breeds decadence"$(Saves an area defined by two right-clicks,$adds a block to the blacklist by crouch right-clicking!)
